_comment: Erections (docs/ERECTION.md): how 4Stim makes scene actors' penises erect, per body. Morph bodies (BodyTalk, Atomic Muscle's .tri install): a body whose .tri has the 'detect' morph gets 'erection' set to 'value' through LooksMenu, under 'keyword' (4Stim has no plugin of its own: a vanilla test keyword nothing else uses), and the 'up' / 'down' morphs follow the penis bend when the skeleton has no bend node. 'triFiles' are tried when the actor's meshes name no .tri. Bodysuits (Atomic Muscle's bodysuit install): an erect body armor put on while the actor is naked. SMP bodies (A-Body) are their physics swap (Physics/A-Body.json).
